source: 1968 Chevrolet Chassis Service Manual, Steering, p.9-7

procedures.title: Steering wheel (Corvette telescoping): remove and install
steps: Remove the shaft nut and washer and pull the wheel and hub together with puller J-2927.
Slide the cancelling cam and spring off the shaft.
Installation (torques per the specs at the rear of the manual): if removed, slide the cancelling cam and spring onto the shaft.
If the hub was separated, reattach it to the wheel with its original screws.
Set the wheel and hub on the column and secure with washer and nut.
Place the spacer on the wheel.
Place the lock knob on the wheel.
Pass the lock screw through the knob, thread it into the shaft and set it to the locked position.
Fasten the spacer to the wheel with 3 screws.
With the knob in the locked position, fasten it to the lock screw with 2 screws.
Take out the 3 spacer screws, then fasten the horn contact to the spacer and wheel with 3 screws.
Plug the column harness back in at the chassis plug.

procedures.title: Steering coupling: remove and install
steps: Removal: disconnect the battery ground cable.
Unplug the column harness and the back-up lamp/neutral safety switch connectors (see figure 9 in the manual).
notes: Steps specific to Camaro, Chevy II, Chevrolet and Chevelle (mast jacket covers, indicator wire) are omitted here.
